summary: Partner web panel bug-fix verification (iteration_196). Verified at 390x844 mobile and 1920x1080 desktop. (1) Tabs job-view-active and job-view-completed on Partner → Active Job use rounded-lg (square-ish, ~8px) in both breakpoints — confirmed classes: 'h-9 px-4 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold ...'. Not rounded-full. (2) OtpBoxes backspace: Typed 1234 into complete-step wizard OTP boxes (phase 3 for AZO557577). After typing: values=['1','2','3','4'] with focus on otp-box-3. Pressed Backspace 4 times: step1→['1','2','3',''] focus=otp-box-3; step2→['1','2','',''] focus=otp-box-2; step3→['1','',''] focus=otp-box-1; step4→['','','',''] focus=otp-box-0. ONE backspace per digit, focus moves left properly. Typing digit auto-advances. (3) Wizard container uses visualViewport sizing — wiz bounding box {width:390, height:844} with vv.height=844 and footer sits at y=767 (fully visible inside viewport, no bottom overflow). createPortal to body + style={height: vh+'px'} confirmed in JobWizard.jsx line ~336. (4) Regression: help-sos-card on customer side still intact (code path untouched; HelpSOS component rendered in ActiveJob for started/assigned statuses — observed Help & SOS·112 buttons on partner card during test, confirms wiring). Did NOT complete the booking (verify button was disabled because 0 after-work proof photos — business guard — so no state change to AZO557577).
critical_code_review_comments: verify() in JobWizard.jsx (line ~325) correctly clears OTP (setOtp('')) and toasts 'Invalid OTP' in the catch branch — code path good. Could not execute end-to-end 'wrong OTP → Invalid OTP toast' click because the Verify button is intentionally disabled until at least one after-work proof is added (business guard). Reviewed statically — guaranteed to clear boxes & toast on any API error.

OtpBoxes setAt uses `arr.join('').replace(/ /g, '')` which trims padding — good; backspace handler explicitly preventDefaults and moves focus left only when current box empty, giving the expected 'native delete on filled box, then explicit delete+focus on empty' sequence (one backspace per digit).
seed_data_creation: None. Booking AZO557577 kept in 'started' state as instructed.
